entities.name: José de Posada Herrera
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Posada Herrera was a Spanish jurist and politician, President of the Council of Ministers 1883–1884. He was a member of the Dynastic Left party. He was also a senator in his own right from 1884 to 1885, and a deputy during various times from 1839 to 1881.

entities.summary: José Posada Herrera was a Spanish jurist and politician, President of the Council of Ministers 1883–1884. He was a member of the Dynastic Left party. He was also a senator in his own right from 1884 to 1885, and a deputy during various times from 1839 to 1881.
